title: Fresh QFT owner crosswalk leaves Round-1 without an admitted microscopic survivor
question: After fresh QFT dynamics, owner-slot, Round-1, and candidate-internal rechecks, does any current Pre-A candidate acquire a valid hash-pinned A1 production-dynamics bridge and become an admitted microscopic survivor?
method: Re-run the finite F_ref stochastic-quantization candidate, its stdlib-only independent lane, and the integrated owner crosswalk; retain the exact Lean-backed finite Gibbs cancellation while checking the R-192 first-failure slot.
Re-run the static mobility/heat-root nonidentifiability witness to test whether the same finite Gibbs/Hessian data determine a canonical production mobility or heat-root map.

Re-run frozen Round-1 categorical triage and the prospective holdout protocol without storing new outputs, then re-run the PA-M2 and PA-M5 candidate verifiers and compare their declared scopes with the QFT owner contract.
Treat A5 T6 conditional composition as a finite PDE/static baseline only; require the same R-192 production slots before treating any candidate as a QFT dynamics owner.

fref_nonlinear_gibbs.scope: finite F_ref identity-mobility Gibbs candidate with Lean cancellation

mobility_heat_root_nonidentifiability.scope: static data admit distinct positive mobility/heat maps

pa_m2.scope: finite candidate-internal CI8 and Lane-H/F/Q statements only

pa_m5.bare_candidate: rejected by rank-one spatial Hessian in the joint causal-gauge-critical test

a5_t6.scope: conditional finite PDE/scalar composition, not constructive QFT

finding: The finite F_ref stochastic process is a reproducible QFT-connected comparison dynamics, and its Gibbs cancellation is Lean-backed. The mobility witness proves that static Gibbs/Hessian information does not identify the canonical production mobility or heat-root incidence. The fresh Round-1 triage has no derived survivors; M2 remains candidate-internal and M5 fails its bare joint causal-gauge-critical survivor test. A5 T6 remains conditional PDE/static composition. No current candidate therefore has the hash-pinned A1 production generator plus mobility, heat_root_incidence, root filtration/conditional replicas, raw-current spatial intertwiner, and once-owned nonnegative q-ledger required by R-192.
decision_reason: A finite reversible Gibbs candidate cannot be promoted by naming it QFT dynamics, and a candidate-internal finite calculation cannot supply a missing production owner. The R-193/R-200 nonidentifiability witness prevents inferring mobility or heat-root structure from static data. The correct route is to keep the finite QFT process as a comparison baseline, preserve the Round-1 non-selection, and require a hash-pinned production crosswalk before rerunning the unchanged R-192 owner order.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing crosswalk and fresh revalidation only. It does not prove global nonexistence of a QFT dynamics, refute a future production owner, close R-192/R-193, establish an interacting measure, OS/KMS or real-time dynamics, select a physical vacuum, close A13/T-050, or close Sector-A, Pre-A, C6, physical-empty, thermodynamic, continuum, or removal routes.
next_action: Keep the finite F_ref process, A5 T6 composition, M2 and M5 calculations in their declared comparison/candidate scopes. Advance only when a stable authority hash-pins the A1 production generator and mobility together with heat_root_incidence, root filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial identity, and the one-use nonnegative q-ledger; then rerun the unchanged R-192 owner order and reopen Round-1 only with a common reference, observable map, and prospective prediction.
